subject.title: feat: add reviewed private AWS workspaces

question: Which branch should be frozen as the canonical landing path for private AWS workspaces before the dedicated-account canary is rerun?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same security-sensitive feature, both remain active, and neither live head currently matches the published proof; branch selection and operational sponsorship require maintainer intent.

options.title: Stabilize this reviewed successor
options.body: Use this PR as canonical, stop parallel edits to the predecessor, and rerun the dedicated-account canary on the final exact head.

options.title: Consolidate into predecessor
options.body: Move all successor hardening into https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1047, freeze that branch, and rerun the complete proof there.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Pause both branches if maintainers do not want to own the dedicated AWS service and its deployment obligations.

recommendation.title: Stabilize this reviewed successor
recommendation.body: Use this PR as canonical, stop parallel edits to the predecessor, and rerun the dedicated-account canary on the final exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main and branch histories make steipete the clearest available owner of branch consolidation and exact-head proof.
